detail.title: CP-UNR-4K2041-4PG
features: Support up to 4Ch. IP Camera Input
Max. 80/80/60 Mbps Incoming/ Recording/ Outgoing bandwidth
AI by NVR: Support 4 Channel IMD
AI by Camera: Support perimeter protection and IMD

General.Perimeter Performance of AI by Camera: Human and vehicle detection on all channels, supporting up to 4 targets per second
General.Abnormality Alarm: Error (No disk, Disk error, Low space, Low quota space, Network disconnection, IP conflict,  MAC conflict), Video loss, Video tampering, Camera offline
General.IMD+ by NVR: 4 Channels: Secondary filtering for human and motor vehicle, Reducing false alarms caused by  leaves, Rain and lighting condition change
General.IMD+ by Camera: Human and vehicle detection on all channels, supporting up to 8 targets per second
General.Network Bandwidth: 80 Mbps incoming, 80 Mbps recording and 60 Mbps outgoing
General.Decoding Capability: AI disabled: 1 Channel 12MP@30 fps, 1 Channel 8MP@30 fps, 2 Channel 6MP@30 fps,                2 Channel 5MP@30 fps, 3 Channel 4MP@30 fps, 6 Channel 2MP@30 fps                                              AI enabled: 1 Channel 8MP@30 fps, 1 Channel 6MP@30 fps, 1 Channel 5MP@30 fps,                            2 Channel 4MP@30 fps, 4 Channel 2MP@30 fps
General.Hard Disk: 1 SATA port. Each disk can contain up to 20 TB. this limit varies depending on the environment  temperature
General.General Alarm: Motion detection, Camera external alarm, PIR alarm
General.Alarm Linkage: Recording, Snapshot, Buzzer, Log, Preset, Email, Tour
General.Protocols: HTTP, HTTPS, TCP/IP, IPv4, IPv6, UDP, NTP, DHCP, DNS, SMTP, IP Filter, DDNS, InstaOn, Auto  connect, ONVIF (Profile T, Profile S, Profile G), CGI, SDK
General.Playback Mode: Instant playback, General playback, Event playback, Tag playback, Smart playback
General.Interface Ports: 2 USB (1 front USB 2.0 port, 1 rear USB 2.0 port), 1 HDMI, 1 VGA
General.Power Consumption: Total output of NVR is <10W (without HDD) Total output power of PoE is 36W, the maximum  output power of a single port is 25.5W
